properties.description: Six integration tests for requirement E: three-layer chain finds axioms not intermediates, alternative derivations give the union, no-inference node has no foundations, voting rules SHOWN WHEN (dropping a principle breaks the conclusion), derived relation lists the design's axioms, and the honest limit text is present.
properties.findings: All 6 tests pass on the branch. The three-layer chain correctly finds only terminal premises; alternative derivations produce the union of axioms; nodes with no inference return empty; the SHOWN WHEN test confirms dropping a principle breaks the conclusion; design_foundations lists all axioms; and the honest limit text is served.
properties.name: Foundations walk tests
